templates.name: Template Nvoip Recording Retention CronJobs
templates.description: NN-2350/NN-4830: watches the retention-only daily cycle, runtime checksum, duplicate/stuck execution and fail-closed legacy flag. Only aggregate log lines are collected.

items.name: Recording retention CronJobs: aggregate cycle summary
items.key: log[{$NVOIP.RETENTION.LOG},"^[A-Z][a-z]{2} [A-Z][a-z]{2} +[0-9]{1,2} [0-9:]{8} [0-9]{4} account_recording_retention selected=[0-9]+ held=[0-9]+ warned=[0-9]+ completed=[0-9]+ empty=[0-9]+ deferred=[0-9]+ deletion_blocked=[0-9]+ delivery_blocked=[0-9]+ failed=[0-9]+ deletion_enabled=(true|false) dry_run=(true|false)$",,,skip]
items.description: Collects only the aggregate summary. Account lines, object keys, addresses and recipients do not match this item.

triggers.expression: nodata(/Template Nvoip Recording Retention CronJobs/log[{$NVOIP.RETENTION.LOG},"^[A-Z][a-z]{2} [A-Z][a-z]{2} +[0-9]{1,2} [0-9:]{8} [0-9]{4} account_recording_retention selected=[0-9]+ held=[0-9]+ warned=[0-9]+ completed=[0-9]+ empty=[0-9]+ deferred=[0-9]+ deletion_blocked=[0-9]+ delivery_blocked=[0-9]+ failed=[0-9]+ deletion_enabled=(true|false) dry_run=(true|false)$",,,skip],26h)=1
triggers.name: Recording retention daily cycle has no completed summary
triggers.description: No aggregate completion was observed for 26 hours. Check the lock, process and helper; do not start a second cycle while the first is uncertain.

triggers.expression: find(/Template Nvoip Recording Retention CronJobs/log[{$NVOIP.RETENTION.LOG},"^[A-Z][a-z]{2} [A-Z][a-z]{2} +[0-9]{1,2} [0-9:]{8} [0-9]{4} account_recording_retention selected=[0-9]+ held=[0-9]+ warned=[0-9]+ completed=[0-9]+ empty=[0-9]+ deferred=[0-9]+ deletion_blocked=[0-9]+ delivery_blocked=[0-9]+ failed=[0-9]+ deletion_enabled=(true|false) dry_run=(true|false)$",,,skip],,"regexp"," failed=[1-9][0-9]* ")=1
triggers.name: Recording retention daily cycle reported failures
triggers.description: The aggregate cycle reported failed>0. Investigate without exporting account identifiers and do not force retries while outcome is uncertain.

triggers.expression: find(/Template Nvoip Recording Retention CronJobs/log[{$NVOIP.RETENTION.LOG},"^[A-Z][a-z]{2} [A-Z][a-z]{2} +[0-9]{1,2} [0-9:]{8} [0-9]{4} account_recording_retention selected=[0-9]+ held=[0-9]+ warned=[0-9]+ completed=[0-9]+ empty=[0-9]+ deferred=[0-9]+ deletion_blocked=[0-9]+ delivery_blocked=[0-9]+ failed=[0-9]+ deletion_enabled=(true|false) dry_run=(true|false)$",,,skip],,"like","deletion_enabled=true")=1
triggers.name: CRITICAL: legacy cancelled-recording deletion flag is enabled
triggers.description: NVOIP_CANCELLED_RECORDING_DELETE_ENABLED must remain absent/false. This is distinct from the Backend exact-version flow. Contain and reconcile before any further CronJobs run.

items.name: Recording retention CronJobs: retention-only marker
items.description: Proves that the scheduled warning cycle did not enter deleted-account LGPD processing.

triggers.expression: nodata(/Template Nvoip Recording Retention CronJobs/log[{$NVOIP.RETENTION.LOG},"^[A-Z][a-z]{2} [A-Z][a-z]{2} +[0-9]{1,2} [0-9:]{8} [0-9]{4} s3_lgpd skipped reason=retention_only$",,,skip],26h)=1
triggers.name: Recording retention cycle did not prove retention-only isolation
triggers.description: The daily run did not emit the retention_only marker. Validate the root cron command before another execution; do not assume deleted-account cleanup stayed isolated.

items.name: Recording retention CronJobs: log modification time

triggers.name: Recording retention log is stale for more than 27 hours
triggers.description: Neither progress nor completion has updated the log. Check cron scheduling, agent access and the retention lock.

items.name: Recording retention CronJobs: runtime CRC32
items.description: The legacy agent supports CRC32 only. The corresponding SHA-256 remains the deployment source of truth in the runbook.

triggers.name: Recording retention runtime differs from the approved artifact
triggers.description: The active Lua file changed. Reconcile its SHA-256, publication receipt and cron mode before declaring the runtime healthy.

items.name: Recording retention CronJobs: running Lua processes

triggers.name: Recording retention has duplicate worker processes
triggers.description: More than one retention-only Lua process is active. Do not terminate or restart blindly; reconcile the flock owner and outcomes first.

triggers.expression: last(/Template Nvoip Recording Retention CronJobs/proc.num[lua,root,,s3_delete_recordings-v3.lua --retention-only])>0 and (time()>070000 or time()<035900)
triggers.name: Recording retention worker is running outside the expected 04:00-07:00 window
triggers.description: The daily cycle is still active outside its normal window. Inspect the current helper and lock; never start a second cycle to test recovery.

macros.description: World-readable aggregate/runtime log already used by the 04:00 root cron.
CRC32 reported by the legacy Zabbix agent for SHA-256 3e1ea3f447b8f8f71a2c56cea9c5bfdf8ded636eeeba9c14927433908c02a578.
